title: FolderNest v2.0.9 Release
changelog: • Instant Folder Creation: Removed the confirmation dialog so projects are created instantly without having to click OK.
• Single Enter Shortcut: Pressing Enter now triggers project creation, with a clean button UI.
• Unlimited Client History: Expanded memory so all past client names are retained and displayed without 15-item limits.
• Smart Client Autocomplete: Real-time suggestion popup as you type client names, with Up/Down arrow navigation and Enter to apply.
• Clean UI Actions: Simplified Update button to clean 'UPDATE NOW' action.
• Streamlined Installer: Clean 'Installed Successfully!' completion dialog and polished interface.
• Remember Last Root Smart Isolation: When ON, keeps your primary designated root folder even when right-clicking inside subdirectories.
• Windows Right-Click Integration: Instant project creation from Explorer context menus.
